'''Wing 3''' was the callsign<ref name="TOTJa" /> of one of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] warships that participated in the [[Second Battle of Onderon]] in [[3998 BBY]].<ref name="TOTJ:TFNU" />

==Characteristics==
Wing 3 was a gray-hulled cylinder-shaped battlecruiser with a prominent command tower, and gun batteries lining the sides of its bow area.<ref name="TOTJ:TFNU" />

==History==
The ship was the first to register the arrival of a civilian ship, the [[Tetan space yacht|Tetan Royal Space Yacht]], ''[[Krath Enchanter]]''. Wing 3 was ordered by [[Nomi Sunrider]] to make them leave the security military zone.<ref name="TOTJa" /> In response, [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] turned his vessel towards the planet and ran past the blockade.<ref name="TOTJ:TFNU" />
